checks.name: SVG structure
checks.evidence: Parsed 49 generated SVGs; titled, outlined, no embedded rasters, scripts or filters.

checks.name: Transparent masters
checks.evidence: Symbol, horizontal, wordmark and stacked PNGs retain transparent backgrounds in both themes.

checks.name: Theme geometry
checks.evidence: Light/dark master pairs have identical alpha geometry, with inverse foreground colors.

checks.name: Desktop icon containers
checks.evidence: Both ICO themes decode at every declared size; 16/24/32px Windows frames use the exact small-cut artwork. Both ICNS files decode.

checks.name: iOS catalogs
checks.evidence: Both 18-slot AppIcon catalogs resolve; all images have correct dimensions and no alpha channel.

checks.name: PWA and avatar safe zones
checks.evidence: All manifest PNG paths/dimensions resolve. Maskable artwork fits the central 80%-diameter circle; avatars fit a circular crop.

checks.name: Android resources
checks.evidence: Parsed 8 resource XMLs; day/night colors, API 26 adaptive and API 33 monochrome variants present. Not compiled with the Android SDK.

checks.name: Text contrast
checks.evidence: Every supplied foreground/muted text pair on its background/surface exceeds 4.5:1. Decorative borders are excluded.

limits: No physical-device install tests or Android/Xcode builds.
No print proof or ICC/spot-color conversion.
Theme SVG browser behavior is checked separately from file-integrity validation.
